summary.text: Jess Hanson is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 55A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Pam Myhra is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Hanson lives in Burnsville, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree from St. Catherine University in 2018.
Her career experience includes working as a senior network representative.
Jess Hanson defeated Republican Gabriela Kroetch in the general elections of November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Hanson's 2025-2026 committee assignments included Children and Families Finance and Policy (as Co-Vice Chair), the House Higher Education Finance and Policy Committee and the House Taxes Committee.
